pending: This section has no verified features yet.
noEvidence: Security checks have not supplied enough evidence for a score.
ratePending: Waiting for a second sample to calculate rates.
processCaution: High usage does not prove malicious activity. Processes are never stopped automatically.
publicIpDisclosure: Only when you click, an HTTPS request is sent to api64.ipify.org. That service can see your public IP address.
publicIpConfirm: Send a request to ipify to check the public IP?
speedDisclosure: Only when clicked, 5 MB is downloaded from Cloudflare. This is not a guaranteed maximum line speed; mobile data may be used.
speedConfirm: Allow a 5 MB download from Cloudflare?
latencyDisclosure: Only when clicked, five TCP connection probes go to 1.1.1.1:443. Failed connections do not prove packet loss.
wifiCaution: Shows cached networks. A fresh scan runs only after clicking; RSSI is not an exact distance.
openWarning: Open network: traffic protection is limited.
roomWalkHelp: Enter a room name and save the current RSSI there. Difference is relative to the first sample; it is not distance or through-wall imaging.
roomSaveFailed: Measurement was not saved. Check Wi-Fi signal availability.
inventoryDisclosure: Only the ARP cache for the current Wi-Fi subnet is read; no discovery packets are sent. The list may be incomplete. A new device is not automatically an attacker.
confirmOwnership: I own or am authorized to manage the current network.
noDevices: No devices found in ARP cache.
channelCaution: Approximate; measure more before changing router settings.
wifiEducation: Cellular 5G and Wi-Fi 5/6/7 are different technologies. Software cannot upgrade unsupported hardware.
projectProtectionInfo: Enter an absolute project path under your home folder. Creating a SHA-256 baseline replaces the prior one. Limits: 10 MB per file, 100 MB total, 2000 files; scans pause on battery or high CPU.
projectConfirm: Read local files in this project?
projectScanFailed: Scan failed. Check path, power and CPU load.
antivirusInfo: Scans the project folder above with ClamAV only after you click. Files are never deleted or moved. Limits: 180 seconds, 2000 files and 100 MB total. A clean result does not guarantee safety.
antivirusConfirm: Scan this folder locally with ClamAV?
antivirusFailed: Antivirus scan failed. Check ClamAV signatures, power and CPU load.
firewall_parse_failed: Firewall response could not be parsed.
firewall_permission: Insufficient access to read UFW and nftables; state remains unknown.
firewall_nft_permission: Insufficient access to read nftables rules.
firewall_policy_unassessed: Rules are readable, but policy has not been assessed.
privacyNotice: No tool provides 100% anonymity or complete protection.
vpn_no_nm_vpn: NetworkManager reports no active VPN; a VPN connected another way may not be detected.
dnsLeakNotRun: DNS leak test not run. Local DNS addresses alone do not prove a leak.
privacyPublicIp: Public IP is checked only when you request it.
alertScope: Only observed high temperature, memory/disk pressure and low battery events. Duplicates are suppressed for 5 minutes; history is kept for 7 days.
learnIntro: Protection has several layers. These topics offer practical guidance; none is an absolute guarantee.
checkUpdates: 1. Install system and app security updates regularly.
checkMfa: 2. Enable MFA or passkeys on important accounts.
checkBackup: 3. Keep separate, tested backups of important files.
checkEncryption: 4. Encrypt your laptop disk and enable screen lock.
checkFirewall: 5. Review unneeded open ports and configure firewall rules carefully.
checkProjects: 6. Keep secrets out of source code; check file integrity and backups.
settingsScope: These values affect only GuardBoard's local alerts; they do not change system settings.
settingsConfirm: Write the new alert thresholds to GuardBoard's local configuration?
settingsFailed: Settings were not saved. Check the values.
config_invalid: Local TOML configuration is invalid; default thresholds are in use temporarily.
optimizerReadOnly: These values are read only. Benchmarks and confirmed changes are not yet implemented.
profile_balanced_description: A balance of power use and speed. Actual results are unknown without measurement.
profile_quiet_description: A suggestion to reduce noise and heat; speed may fall.
profile_performance_description: A suggestion for higher speed; power use, heat and noise may rise.
profileNotApplied: Proposal only — no system change was applied.
local_apt_config: Local APT configuration; does not prove package state.
sshd_effective_unreadable: Effective SSH settings could not be read.
sshd_effective_config: sshd -T output; does not prove the service is active.
secure_boot_unreadable: Secure Boot status could not be read.
service_state_unreadable: Service state could not be determined.
